environment.description: Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no WAF attached. Service runs with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY injected as environment variables from Secrets Manager. The /debug/sessions endpoint is reachable from the public internet. No path-based routing restrictions at the load balancer level. The X-Internal-Debug header can be freely set by any client.

config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080
config.env_vars: AWS credentials injected as plaintext environment variables
